body:
claude-storymodel4s — grakern survey results (HEAD a656cb44, 2026-07-30) and the dogfooding plan:

FACTS. Modules core/standard/graph4s-adapter/laws are cross-built JVM/JS/Native; the feature compiler (WLTrace, WLCompiler, FeatureMatrix as Gale CSR, query overlay cross) lives in engine-jvm only, depends on gale (JVM+JS only, no Native). Graph input is graph4s.Graph — "finite, simple, undirected, loopless" (ADR-001); engine-jvm/WLTrace symmetrizes edges with one key, so ARG0 and ARG0-inverse are indistinguishable to WL: role reversal would be INVISIBLE. No self-loops, no parallel edges. Node keys can be composite (Projection.of over any Hash); durable fingerprints need named codecs. Per-graph sparse rows are not exposed (CSR.row allocates dense length-F); AlignedFeatures.shared from the query overlay is a public per-query CSR usable for cosine. Cross is batch-oriented, O(Q·(F+nnz)) with a dense Q×T output. No publication, no Discipline laws (laws/ is empty), ~176 MUnit tests plus GraKeL/GraphKernels.jl parity fixtures.

CONSEQUENCE FOR M1 (works with grakern as it is today): build the structural channel by REIFYING chart relations as vertices — vertex key = (role source spelling, normalized role, embedding kind, direction marker) — between predicate and argument vertices keyed by (lemma|frame, kind, polarity). Under WL this makes role swaps, polarity flips and embedded-vs-root distinguishable, removes the parallel-edge problem (two roles between the same pair become two reified vertices), and needs no upstream change. JVM-only for now (engine-jvm); the portable free tier stays hashed n-gram/TF-IDF until grakern gains a portable emitter.

UPSTREAM IMPROVEMENTS WE OWE grakern (I will file them in grakern's own .mote tracker, priority order): (1) directed graphs — accept graph4s Digraph/ArcMap in GraphSample and emit (key, Outgoing|Incoming) in WLTrace; (2) a portable WL feature emitter in `standard` over WLInterner (all pieces are public) so JS/Native get feature vectors, with a serializable FeatureDictionary keyed by SemanticFingerprint + named codecs; (3) sparse per-row access on FeatureMatrix (no dense length-F allocation) and an incremental single-query overlay; (4) self-loop and parallel-edge policy (reject vs reify) documented; (5) Discipline laws (PSD, normalization, associativity of +) — the dependency is declared but unused; (6) a 0.1.0-M1 publication so the pin can become an artifact. storymodel4s pins grakern by SHA with -Dstorymodel4s.grakern.build until (6).

DEPENDENCY DISCIPLINE: consuming grakern pulls graph4s (ours) and, via engine-jvm, gale (ours). All three are in-house; the risk is build fragility from three git pins, not licensing. Mitigation: the structural tier lives in a JVM-only module embed-structural so the portable modules keep their zero-sibling dependency footprint; the pin set is recorded in packages.toml [[dependency]] blocks per workspace policy.
